status: preview: not reviewed by a tax professional for this country

conventions.amounts: decimal strings; quantities in asset units (exact multiples of 1e-11, Kassiber's msat); fiat in the country currency
conventions.times: ISO 8601 with offset; every date rule uses the local date in `timezone`
conventions.expected: the spec's hand-computed results, which scripts/tax-country-vectors.py check recomputes; `rp2.computed` is RP2's plugin on the same inputs

notes: Quantities are decimal strings in asset units (Kassiber stores msat; every quantity here is an exact multiple of 1e-11). Yen amounts are decimal strings; unrounded values are exact in the engine's 32-digit context. Per asset and year the block mirrors the NTA 暗号資産の計算書 (総平均法用 / 移動平均法用). `rp2.computed` records what RP2's JP plugin does with the same inputs (it refuses: the pinned fork disabled it); see the spec for the RP2 report template comparison.
